```{r}
df = read.csv("varicelle.csv")
head(df)
```
```{r}
#convert df to time series
x = ts(df,start = c(1931,1),end=c(1972,6),frequency = 12)
plot(x)
```
```{r}
#plot auto correlogram 
acf(x)
```
```{r}
pacf(x)
```
```{r}
library(forecast)
seasonplot(x)
```
